label: Issues raised per request
description: Stands in for the number of issues carried by a letter of review. Nothing in the platform is a letter of review yet, so this counts every issue raised against a request instead: the same number where a request is reviewed once, and an over-count where it goes round more than once. Requests that drew no issue are counted, because a request that was sent and drew none is the outcome this number exists to encourage and leaving it out would flatter every figure.
